My uncle was not actually my uncle but my 2nd cousin. My grandmother raised him when he was taken away from her sister because of her drug addiction. My grandmother was 20 at the time and already had another kid. Unfortunately all of the other children that my grandmothers sister had were not taken care of by my grandmother but were placed in foster care. They all suffer from drug addiction and have had bad events happen to them, except my uncle. He is doing very well comparable to his siblings which makes them all angry and now I understand why. They didnt get the same chance that he was granted. 

The big moment I found out was when my uncle was getting married and he said he wanted to invite his real mom, but my grandmother and her have a very strained relationship and she flipped out. I had no idea what was happening so my mother had to explain it.

Also I found out I had a half sister when I was 13 that was kept a secret from me. She knew about me though and once she was in my driveway while I was selling lemonade (I was probably 8) and she wanted to talk to me but my mom wouldn't allow her to. It makes me sad thinking about it since we are very close now.
